source.title: Copper-Catalyzed Suzuki-Miyaura Coupling of Unactivated Alkyl Halides with Arylborons

reaction.notes: CuBr·SMe2 (5 mol%), bathophenanthroline (7.5 mol%), NaOtBu (1.5 equiv), toluene (20 mL), 80 °C, 24 h, air; combined 73% yield (65% + 8% from second collection).

workup.details: Filter through a short pad of layered silica gel (2.0 cm) and diatomite (0.10 cm), eluting with ethyl acetate (3 × 50 mL).
Concentrate the filtrate by rotary evaporation (16 mbar, 38 °C) to a brown oil; dissolve in dichloromethane (8.0 mL) and add silica gel (7 g); remove solvent to give a yellow powder on silica.

purification.stationary_phase: Silica gel (160 g; 6.0 cm diameter; 20 cm height), petroleum ether eluent
purification.eluent: Petroleum ether (total ~700 mL) following a 350 mL wet-pack
purification.fractions: Collect 15 mL fractions; combine 26–37 for major product; 38–44 contain additional product requiring a second column (50 g silica; 3.0 cm × 25 cm) to afford more product.

notes: Heavy-walled pressure vessel with Teflon cap; reagents added under air; mixture heated in 80 °C oil bath for 24 h.
Combined isolated yield: 73% (65% from first collection + 8% from second collection).

original_procedure: An oven-dried 150-mL heavy-walled pressure vessel, equipped with a Teflon-coated, football-shaped magnetic stir bar, is charged with 4-chlorophenylboronic acid pinacol ester (8.59 g, 36.0 mmol, 1.8 equiv), sodium tert-butoxide (2.88 g, 30.0 mmol, 1.5 equiv), copper(I) bromide–dimethyl sulfide (206 mg, 1.0 mmol, 5.0 mol%), bathophenanthroline (499 mg, 1.5 mmol, 7.5 mol%), and bromocyclohexane (2.50 mL, 3.3 g, 20.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) under air. Toluene (20 mL), dried over MgSO4 and filtered, is added, the vessel is sealed with a Teflon cap, and the mixture is heated at 80 °C for 24 h. After cooling, the reaction is filtered through a short pad of layered silica gel/diatomite and eluted with ethyl acetate (3 × 50 mL). The filtrate is concentrated (16 mbar, 38 °C), the residue is adsorbed on silica (7 g), and purified by flash chromatography (silica, petroleum ether) to give 1-cyclohexyl-4-chlorobenzene in 65% yield; additional product (8%) is obtained from later fractions by a second column, for a combined yield of 73%.
